decisions.measurement_route: spatial orienting/reorienting task or eye-movement latency under controlled cueing
decisions.boundary: Orienting can be voluntary or involuntary; it is not synonymous with capture.

decisions.measurement_route: trial-level lapse markers in sustained-attention/vigilance paradigms
decisions.boundary: A lapse is transient and must be distinguished from a time-on-task decrement.

decisions.measurement_route: disengagement/reorienting cost under cueing or competition paradigms
decisions.boundary: Disengagement releases current priority; it is not simply distractor suppression.
Retained as module-level mechanism description, not an independent latent node.

decisions.measurement_route: explicit awareness of a specific knowledge gap paired with curiosity/seeking measure
decisions.boundary: Knowledge gaps can produce curiosity, frustration, avoidance, or indifference depending on appraisal.
Represent competence/mastery contribution inside learning-progress dynamics until separable evidence requires a split.
Personal relevance changes valuation; do not duplicate self-relevance as a value neuron.

decisions.measurement_route: effort/cost rating or choice model estimating subjective cost
decisions.boundary: Cost is context- and option-specific; not all non-choice reflects high subjective cost.

decisions.measurement_route: pre-outcome expected-value rating/model or reward anticipation task
decisions.boundary: Expected value precedes outcome and should remain distinct from experienced value.
Experienced value may update but is not identical to prediction error.

decisions.measurement_route: loss/punishment value task or aversive-outcome valuation
decisions.boundary: Human punishment-value evidence is less mature than reward-value evidence.
Use specific approach/avoidance/confrontation tendencies rather than a generic action-activation node.
Do not encode all positive emotions as one mechanism.
Do not encode all negative emotions as one mechanism.

decisions.measurement_route: validated mixed-emotion paradigm with bivariate or multivariate assessment
decisions.boundary: Mixed emotion is co-occurrence, not merely a weak correlation between positive and negative affect.

decisions.measurement_route: action-tendency measure tied to event appraisal/emotion context
decisions.boundary: Confrontation/mobilization is conditional and not a one-to-one emotion label.

decisions.measurement_route: self-concept/identity representation measure matched to the relevant self-domain
decisions.boundary: Personal self-concept is broader than one salient social category.
Boundary maintenance is one possible identity-protective response, not a universal reaction to threat.
Motive authenticity remains a facet/hypothesis under genuineness until discriminant validity is established.
Behavioral consistency is source-history evidence feeding judgments rather than a latent trust state.

decisions.measurement_route: history-based reliability judgment using prior source outcomes/accuracy records
decisions.boundary: A reliable track record can be domain-specific and does not guarantee benevolence or current accuracy.
Do not claim a standalone PSI cognitive factor without construct-specific validation.
Episode affect can accompany PSI but is not yet a standalone canonical PSI factor.
PSR maintenance is one-sided relational maintenance and not reciprocal interpersonal maintenance.
Exposure history conditions familiarity/connection but is not itself relational closeness.
Use the validated intimacy construct rather than duplicate closeness/intimacy nodes.
Recent review finds parasocial attachment substantially under-studied relative to PSI/PSR.
Insufficient evidence for a canonical loss-sensitivity node distinct from attachment/intimacy.

decisions.measurement_route: motive-specific affective-expression measure tied to an actual/intended transmission decision
decisions.boundary: Affective expression is a motive and cannot be inferred from arousal or share count alone.
Audience composition plus privacy/reputation costs generate inhibition contextually.
Treat as individual-difference/moderator unless a task-specific learning parameter is explicitly estimated.
Derive from multiple indicators; never use as a primitive evidence source.
Arbitration is one model class, not canonical ontology truth.
Override is an emergent behavioral outcome of goal control plus changed cues/outcomes/contingencies.
